thesis: A law exceeds an accidental inventory by supporting stable counterfactual relationships within a domain.
role: Define observations, laws, theories and models without conflation.

ideas.statement: A useful law states its domain and risks contradiction; fitted regularity or vague universality is insufficient.
Human notation, real relations and governing metaphysical entities are distinct; model selection preserves task-relevant relations.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: A subway map can legitimately omit distances while an evacuation map must preserve different relationships.

audit.notes: Complete batch read; headings and navigation excluded from idea ranking.
